subject: Safety gate credit request for VPC pilot
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medframe.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot credits for VPC pilot - security gating

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look. We're kicking off a 30-day VPC pilot to evaluate Redwood for a patient-facing feature. Our security team requires a couple of gating items before we can sign off on any external pilot credits:

- SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) evidence
- Recent penetration test summary (redacted is fine)
- Audit log retention and access controls for the VPC environment

We'd like to request promotional credits to cover the pilot (estimate ~15k tokens/day peak, ~8k average) so we can run full integration and perf checks on private infra. Can you share what evidence you need and whether Redwood can reserve a short dedicated capacity window during the trial?

I've attached our high-level security requirements (medframe_security_requirements.pdf). Happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

—
Alice Jenkins
Head of Integrations, MedFrame Health
alice.jenkins@medframe.com
security@medframe.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medframe.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits for VPC pilot - security gating

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the attachment. Welcome — excited to work with MedFrame.

Quick outline of next steps from our side so we can evaluate a credits uplift for a private/VPC pilot:

1) Please upload SOC2 attestation and a redacted pen-test summary (ok to share as PDFs).
2) Complete the short VPC POC credit form I've attached (VPC_POC_Credit_Form.pdf) — asks about expected token volumes and retention needs.
3) Legal: sign our DPA (we can route DocuSign once legal confirms scope).

If the documents check out we can provision a conditional promotional credit (initial approval up to $15,000 of compute credit tied to the pilot period). This would be contingent on the DPA and evidence being in place. If MedFrame needs a higher buffer based on your volume estimate, flag that in the form and we'll review with finance.

Marcus — can you confirm whether a short dedicated capacity window (2–4 hours/day for the first two weeks) is feasible on our side without an SOW?

Laura — FYI on the DPA ask / any guidance on escalated credit amounts for Health customers.

Thanks,

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Thanks Vanessa — attaching the SOC2 Type II (MedFrame_SOC2_TypeII.pdf) and a short pen-test summary (internal_pen_test_summary.docx).

A couple clarifications from security:
- Audit logs must be retained for 90 days with role-based access controls; can you confirm retention and RBAC options in the VPC environment?
- MedFrame will need a named technical contact at Redwood for onboarding and one escalation contact.

Estimated usage: we expect ~10k tokens/day average first week, ramp to ~20k/day by week 3 if perf looks good. We listed 25k/day as an upper bound on the form.

Do you need anything else to get legal moving? We can sign the DPA quickly if you send it over.

—
Alice

Hi Alice — great, thanks for the docs and the estimates. Good news: we've provisionally approved a $15,000 compute credit to support your 30-day VPC pilot. Final disbursement is conditional on the following being completed by the start of the pilot:

1) Signed DPA (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/abcd-1234)
2) SOC2 Type II attestation uploaded to our secure intake (we have your copy)
3) Redacted penetration test summary uploaded (we have the doc)

Operational notes:
- We've scheduled a 2-hour dedicated integration window for the first week; our ops lead will reach out to schedule.
- Audit log retention: VPC audit logs can be retained for 90 days; RBAC is supported via our account roles (we'll map MedFrame roles in onboarding).

Next steps for you: sign the DPA link above, and confirm a 2-hour window next Tuesday or Wednesday morning PST for integration. Once legal confirms the DPA is signed, finance will apply the $15k credit to your account and I will send onboarding instructions (VPC_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf).

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/MedFrame

If you need a higher buffer after you see perf, tell us and we can review a mid-pilot top-up.

Best,
